description: Office of the Governor, Uva Province - Extention of Time of the Inquiry Council, Kataragama Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notification concerns the suspension of a local government authority (Katharagama Pradeshiya Sabha) and the appointment of a retired judicial officer to investigate the matter. The content focuses on the exercise of gubernatorial powers over local administration and the extension of a judicial investigation, which falls under law enforcement and judicial oversight of local government. This aligns with Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement), which covers law enforcement regulations, procedures, and the appointment of officers for investigative purposes.
